observed_vs_expected: The expectation that 'best_target_score should increase as cavity thicknesses approach half-wave resonance' showed initial alignment (R1→R2: +0.00232) but reversed sharply in R3, dropping to 0.7447381097603889. This occurred because thicknesses moved *away* from resonance rather than closer. 'Tightest_margin should improve as mirror stack reflectivity increases' holds; the margin remained strongly positive at 0.5259301041578643. 'Valid_candidates may decrease if cavity coupling causes unrealistic thickness' did not manifest; the count stayed constant at 9, indicating thickness constraints were not breached.
deviation_mechanism: The score collapse is caused by optical detuning from excessive cavity thinning. Key resonance-building layers shrank from proven optima (~467.7 nm and ~389.2 nm) to deep-subwavelength scales (~134.7 nm and ~236.1 nm) in the latest evaluation cycle. This loss of optical path length breaks the half-wave resonance condition ($\lambda/2n$) required for constructive interference in the filter passband, directly degrading the transmission/reflection figure-of-merit. The persistently positive tightest_margin (0.5259301041578643) confirms the stack geometry remains fabricable; the performance loss is purely due to moving the design out of its resonant tuning window.
continue_rationale: Three rounds have executed, yet the trajectory shows a severe detuning event rather than convergence exhaustion. The marginal-gain stop condition (<1e-3 improvement for two consecutive rounds) was never approached, and tightest_margin remains well within feasible bounds. Because the degradation traces to a correctable optimizer jump away from proven resonant thicknesses, continued exploration with tightened initialization bounds will likely recover high-performance designs without violating resource limits.
insight_for_next: Anchored reinitialization: restrict the optimizer search bounds for layers 1 and 2 to ±15 nm of their round 2 optimal values (Layer 1: [452.69, 482.69] nm anchored at 467.6949 nm; Layer 2: [374.19, 404.19] nm anchored at 389.1909 nm).
